title: DashboardPersonalWork
wrapsNative: ScrollView with a VStack: a horizontal ScrollView of MonarchStatCard (key figures), MonarchInsightStrip, and MonarchDashboardGrid of MonarchWidget sections; the title is .navigationTitle and the period a menu Picker in .toolbar
summary: A recipe, not a component: a person's own home screen ("My work") with key figures, insights and sections for today, assigned work, what is due, progress and recent activity.
whenToUse: As the Home tab of a product where people manage their own tasks, approvals and schedule.
whenNotToUse: For a portfolio of assets or contracts use the dashboard-portfolio recipe. For one list of today's events and tasks use the today-panel recipe on its own.
api: Sections: Today (MonarchEventChip with variant .bar and Toggle with .toggleStyle(.monarchCheckbox)), Assigned to you (MonarchBarList), Due soon (rows with MonarchBadge), Progress (ProgressView with .progressViewStyle(.monarchLinear)), Recent activity (MonarchActivityTimeline with density .compact)

states.name: home
states.description: Key figures that scroll sideways, the insight strip, then one column of widgets on phones (two or three on iPad, from MonarchDashboardGrid).

states.name: arranging
states.description: isEditing on MonarchDashboardGrid shows Move earlier and Move later on each widget; the order is stored in layout.

states.name: loading and errors
states.description: Each widget takes state .loading, .empty(…) or .failed(…) with onRetry; stat cards take isLoading and errorMessage.

states.name: section left out
states.description: Every section is optional: leave its tile out of the grid (for example Your team for people who manage nobody).

appearance: The theme's canvas with Monarch widget cards, stat cards, the insight strip in its tones and the system menu picker. All colours are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web DashboardPersonalWork is one template component with a header, a KPI row, an insight strip and a grid of named slots. On iOS it is a recipe: a screen in a NavigationStack, with the title as navigationTitle and the period and actions in the toolbar, because a phone home screen is a scrolling column and the app decides which sections exist. The KPI row is a horizontal ScrollView of MonarchStatCard rather than a wrapping row, so the figures stay one line high on a phone. Sections are MonarchWidget in MonarchDashboardGrid, which is one column on phones and can be arranged. The web's messages are the app's own strings here. Android composes the same recipe.
accessibility: The title is a header (navigationTitle or the header trait).
Each stat card is read as its label, value and change; each widget title is a header.
The grid is a container named "Dashboard"; in arrange mode Move earlier and Move later are buttons and every move is announced (MonarchDashboardGrid).
Tasks are checkboxes read with their state; Overdue is a word with an icon.
Every control is at least 44 points.
edgeCases: Store layout per person (for example in AppStorage) so the arrangement survives launches; unknown ids are skipped.
The grid does not scroll: keep it inside the screen's ScrollView.
At the accessibility text sizes the grid is one column on every device.

examples.title: One person’s work, arrangeable
examples.code:
ScrollView {
    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.space4) {
        Text("My work").monarchTextStyle(.heading)
        Text("Priya Raman · Product team")
        MonarchSegmentedControl(
            "Period",
            selection: $period,
            items: [
                MonarchSegmentedItem("Today", value: "Today"),
                MonarchSegmentedItem("Last 7 days", value: "Last 7 days"),
                MonarchSegmentedItem("Last 30 days", value: "Last 30 days"),
                MonarchSegmentedItem("This quarter", value: "This quarter"),
                MonarchSegmentedItem("Custom", value: "Custom"),
            ],
            size: .sm
        )
        MonarchButton(isEditing ? "Done" : "Arrange", variant: .secondary, size: .sm) { isEditing.toggle() }
        LazyVGrid(columns: [GridItem(.adaptive(minimum: 130), spacing: theme.spacing.space3)], spacing: theme.spacing.space3) {
                MonarchStatCard("Assigned to you", value: 12.0).id("assigned")
                MonarchStatCard("Due this week", value: 4.0).id("due")
                MonarchStatCard(
                    "Done this month",
                    value: 27.0,
                    change: MonarchMetricChange(0.17, comparison: "vs last month")
                )
                .id("done")
        }
        MonarchInsightStrip(
            "Insights",
            insights: [
                MonarchInsight(
                    id: "blocked",
                    title: "Two of your tasks are blocked",
                    why: "Both wait on the design review on Wednesday.",
                    tone: .info,
                    origin: .rule
                )
            ]
        )
        MonarchDashboardGrid(
            tiles,
            layout: $layout,
            itemLabel: \.title,
            span: { $0.isWide ? .two : .one },
            isEditing: isEditing,
            content: { tile in section(tile) }
        )
    }
    .padding(theme.spacing.space4)
}
.environment(\.locale, Locale(identifier: "en-GB"))
.environment(\.timeZone, TimeZone(identifier: "Europe/London") ?? .gmt)
.frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: theme.spacing.space24 * 6)
